provenance.note: Polyglot does not commit generated fixture blobs; these cases were regenerated from its pinned SQLGlot tag.

selection: Statically ported cases whose syntax is represented by Cyqwel; the test harness never filters or skips cases at runtime.
excludedCategories: Administrative, procedural, trigger, grant, hint, and engine table-option syntax outside Cyqwel relational AST scope.
Advanced extension syntax not represented by Cyqwel, including JSON/path operators, arrays and ranges, table functions, PIVOT, MATCH_RECOGNIZE, and TABLESAMPLE.
Cases that assert SQLGlot warning, error, formatting, or identifier-normalization behavior rather than parse/generate stability.
